content: === Introduction ===
This article contains a list of commercially available gene therapies.
=== Gene therapies ===
<info> Alipogene tiparvovec (Glybera): AAV-based treatment for lipoprotein lipase deficiency (no longer commercially available)
<info> Axicabtagene ciloleucel (Yescarta): treatment for large B-cell lymphoma[1]
<info> Beremagene geperpavec (Vyjuvek): treatment of wounds.[2]
<info> Betibeglogene autotemcel (Zynteglo): treatment for beta thalassemia[3]
<info> Brexucabtagene autoleucel (Tecartus): treatment for mantle cell lymphoma and acute lymphoblastic leukemia[4][5]
<info> Cambiogenplasmid (Neovasculgen): treatment for vascular endothelial growth factor peripheral artery disease
<info> Ciltacabtagene autoleucel (Carvykti): treatment for multiple myeloma[6]
<info> Delandistrogene moxeparvovec (Elevidys): treatment for Duchenne muscular dystrophy[7][8]
<info> Elivaldogene autotemcel (Skysona): treatment for cerebral adrenoleukodystrophy[9]
<info> Etranacogene dezaparvovec (Hemgenix): AAV-based treatment for hemophilia B[10]
<info> Exagamglogene autotemcel (Casgevy): treatment for sickle cell disease.[11]
<info> Gendicine: treatment for head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
<info> Idecabtagene vicleucel (Abecma): treatment for multiple myeloma[12]
<info> Lovotibeglogene autotemcel (Lyfgenia): treatment for sickle cell disease.[11]
<info> Nadofaragene firadenovec (Adstiladrin): treatment for bladder cancer[13]
<info> Obecabtagene autoleucel (Aucatzyl): treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukemia[14][15]
<info> Onasemnogene abeparvovec (Zolgensma): AAV-based treatment for spinal muscular atrophy[16]
<info> Prademagene zamikeracel (Zevaskyn): recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa[17]
<info> Revakinagene taroretcel (Encelto): treatment of macular telangiectasia type 2[18]
<info> Strimvelis: treatment for adenosine deaminase deficiency (ADA-SCID)
<info> Talimogene laherparepvec (Imlygic): treatment for melanoma in people who have recurring skin lesions[19]
<info> Tisagenlecleucel (Kymriah): treatment for B cell lymphoblastic leukemia[20]
<info> Valoctocogene roxaparvovec (Roctavian): treatment for hemophilia A[21][22][23]
<info> Voretigene neparvovec (Luxturna): AAV-based treatment for Leber congenital amaurosis[24]
